response.text: Now the invoice-to-GL tie-out, period/posting date checks, and duplicates.

arguments.sql: select i."INV_ID", i."INV_NO", i."INV_AMT", i."JRNL_NO", h."SRC_CD", h."SRC_REF", coalesce(sum(l."CR_AMT") filter (where trim(l."ACCT_CD")='2000'),0) ap_cr, coalesce(sum(l."DR_AMT") filter (where trim(l."ACCT_CD")='2000'),0) ap_dr, sum(l."DR_AMT") dr, sum(l."CR_AMT") cr from "APINVH" i left join "GLJRNH" h on h."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" left join "GLJRNL" l on l."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" group by 1,2,3,4,5,6 having h."JRNL_NO" is null or coalesce(sum(l."CR_AMT") filter (where trim(l."ACCT_CD")='2000'),0)<>i."INV_AMT" or h."SRC_REF" is distinct from i."INV_NO" order by 1

select h."JRNL_NO", h."PRD_ID", h."POST_DT", p."STRT_DT", p."END_DT", p."STAT_CD", p."CLOSE_DT", h."SRC_CD", h."MEMO" from "GLJRNH" h join "GLPERD" p on p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID" where h."POST_DT"<p."STRT_DT" or h."POST_DT">p."END_DT" or (p."STAT_CD"='C' and h."POST_DT">p."CLOSE_DT") order by 1
select regexp_replace(upper(trim("INV_NO")),'[^A-Z0-9]','','g') k, "VEND_CD", count(*), array_agg("INV_ID"), array_agg("INV_NO"), array_agg("INV_AMT") from "APINVH" group by 1,2 having count(*)>1
select "VEND_CD", "INV_AMT", "INV_DT", count(*), array_agg("INV_ID"), array_agg("INV_NO") from "APINVH" group by 1,2,3 having count(*)>1
